name: @projexlight/kafka-runtime
summary: Kafka client runtime — typed producer/consumer wrappers, schema-registry integration, dead-letter-queue plumbing, idempotent-write helpers. The wire for every cross-SDK event flow (UsageEvent.v1, AuditEvent.v1, lineage events).

hooks.name: initKafka
hooks.description: Initialize the Kafka client; warm topic + consumer-group registry.

hooks.name: closeKafka
hooks.description: Graceful shutdown — flush producer + commit consumer offset.

hooks.name: publishMessage
hooks.description: Publish a typed message; idempotent on the message_id key.

hooks.name: subscribe
hooks.description: Subscribe to a topic + register a handler; auto-acks on success, sends to DLQ on persistent failure.

scenarios.title: SDK publishes a UsageEvent.v1
scenarios.when_to_use: Every metered SDK op — meter.report() ultimately calls publishMessage to the meter inbox topic.
scenarios.example_code:
import { publishMessage } from '@projexlight/kafka-runtime';
await publishMessage('meter.usage.event.v1', usageEvent);
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message lands in the topic. Producer ack confirms durability before the call returns.

scenarios.title: Consumer subscribes; persistent failures go to DLQ
scenarios.when_to_use: Background projector — subscribe(); handler runs per message; persistent errors after retries land in <topic>.dlq for replay.
scenarios.example_code:
import { subscribe } from '@projexlight/kafka-runtime';
subscribe('meter.usage.event.v1', async (msg) => { await rollUp(msg); });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Handler runs per message. Auto-ack on success; DLQ on persistent failure. Consumer offset commits per batch.

scenarios.title: SIGTERM triggers flush + commit
scenarios.when_to_use: Rolling deploy — closeKafka flushes producer + commits consumer offsets so no message gets dropped or duplicated across pod restarts.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Zero message loss + at-least-once delivery preserved across deploys.

compliance_posture.notes: Idempotent producer + DLQ for unrecoverable messages ensures no audit-relevant event silently drops. Schema-registry pin prevents shape drift.
